description: Replace one app's key and keep its rules, limits, expiry and call count. The old key stops working at once (no overlap) and the new key is shown once. Use it when a key may have leaked; to remove the app entirely use gate_revoke_app.

admin_key.description: The project admin key (ga_...). Read it from the .env; never print it.

project_id.description: The project id from gate_create_project, e.g. p1a2b3...

name: gate_rotate_app_key
title: Replace an app key
